name: AWS Data Sources
description: Query Athena, S3 Tables (Iceberg), DynamoDB, S3, and a Bedrock Knowledge Base from the sandbox

name: Voice of the Customer (LLM)
description: Mine raw reviews with Bedrock LLMs — sentiment, issue themes, extraction, semantic search — then join to Athena revenue for a product action plan

name: ML: Return-Risk Scorekeeper
description: Train a scikit-learn model on Athena features labelled by the Iceberg order lifecycle — by hand and as a one-line train_model call — ship it to S3 with save_model/load_model, score the catalog into a product action list, then optionally export to ONNX and deploy to real-time endpoints in BOTH hosting flavors (serverless + instance) with stop/start

name: SageMaker: Train at Scale
description: Train a return-risk model on SageMaker-managed compute with the sm_* helpers — build features from Athena + Iceberg, submit a non-blocking sm_train job, poll it, sm_load_model → predict and predict_batch the catalog, then optionally sm_deploy_serverless it as a serverless real-time endpoint (sm_predict / sm_delete_endpoint)

name: Big Data ML: Train from S3, Serve Two Ways
description: Train on data too big for the VM: UNLOAD a joined Athena+Iceberg feature table to S3 (shown both as the unload_athena_to_s3 helper and a native SQL UNLOAD cell — rows never enter the sandbox), sm_train straight from the S3 pointer across xgboost + lightgbm, build a nightly hold list with predict_batch, then deploy the champion TWO ways — serverless for the batch job, instance for a real-time checkout widget

name: CloudWatch Logs Analysis
description: Analyze this notebook's own CloudWatch logs with no setup — tail/grep/Insights/plain-English (read_logs, grep_logs, tail_logs, ask_logs), chart log levels and an error trend, then go fleet-wide across every MicroVM log group

name: Sales Data Analysis
description: Query real orders from Athena with SQL, then chart top products and revenue trends with Plotly

name: Time Series Forecasting
description: Turn real S3 clickstream into a daily series, analyze weekday/seasonal patterns, and forecast with confidence intervals

name: Memory & CPU Burst Demo
description: Watch the MicroVM scale memory and CPU under heavy load

name: Reactive Dependencies
description: Reactive auto-run across dependent SQL and Python cells

name: Interactive Parameters
description: Parameterize notebooks with interactive widgets, including dropdowns driven dynamically by a variable

name: Data Cleaning & Transform
description: Reconcile real customers and orders into a tidy table — parse dates, handle join nulls, derive tiers, validate with SQL

name: Statistical Analysis
description: Test a real hypothesis (verified vs unverified reviews, or Premium vs Standard customers) with a t-test, effect size, and CIs

name: Public API Data Analysis
description: A market-expansion brief from free no-auth APIs: market size (World Bank), operating conditions (Open-Meteo), treasury exposure (CoinGecko)

name: Helper Functions Demo
description: Tour every pre-loaded helper: discover them with helpers(), load from S3/DynamoDB/Athena/Aurora/URLs, query a Bedrock Knowledge Base, run LLMs, train a model in one line with train_model, profile, visualize, export, and price your session

name: Notebook Analytics & Cost
description: See your open notebooks' runs and cost, then pick one to deep-dive its versions, runs, execution times, CPU, memory, and cost (needs --AuroraSetup)
